Introduction

ADYA was a five-member girl group under Starting House Entertainment. The group made their official debut on May 9, 2023, with a self-titled single album ADYA.

They are believed to have silently disbanded around February 2025 following a prolonged period of social media inactivity, coinciding with the official shutdown of their agency, Starting House Entertainment.
